SYNTHETIC_DATA_NOTICE: All data in this directory are artificial and were generated by GeoExplain for demonstration and testing. They do not describe any real place or observation.

columns.elevation: Elevation above an arbitrary datum (metres, synthetic)
columns.distance_to_water: Distance to nearest synthetic water cell (metres)
columns.target: binary event indicator drawn as Bernoulli(p_true) (classification demo)
columns.landcover: string class derived from features + 8% label noise (multi-class demo)

generating_coefficients.intercept: solved numerically so that mean(p) equals target_prevalence
